notes: Test LoRAs is now LoRA health — one report card per LoRA instead of a wall of log lines, with a Fix button next to every problem that has a mechanical remedy. Each configured LoRA, Settings and per-character alike, is checked against everything that silently breaks one: whether fal can actually fetch the URL (a Civitai link without a token quietly returns a login page), whether the file sits on the RunPod volume under the name ComfyUI will ask for, what Civitai knows about the model, and whether the strength is in the range fal accepts. The fixes do the work in place: a LoRA missing from the volume gets an Install button that rents the throwaway CPU pod for just that file — or one pod for everything missing at once — with the copy-a-script route beside it; a model whose base isn't FLUX gets switched to its FLUX version when one exists; empty trigger words fill in from Civitai's metadata; a model Civitai flags 18+ that isn't gated gets the 18+ gate added to WHEN; an out-of-range strength resets; and a file whose model was deleted from Civitai can be removed where it lives, character cards included. After every fix the whole report re-runs, so the verdicts on screen are never stale.
